1: Thrusters and steering systems, which affect how quickly your ship moves.
2: Weapons that your crew uses when trying to capture a ship.
3: Items you can purchase or sell but that are not outfits that can be installed in a ship.
4: The type of outfits this weapon consumes when fired.
5: Units of ammo this weapon consumes when fired.
7: The initial velocity of projectiles fired by this weapon. Some weapons have projectiles that accelerate or decelerate from this initial value as they travel.
8: The multiplier applied to the damage of this weapon once its projectile has reached the maximum dropoff range.
9: The starting and ending range between which the damage of this weapon ramps from 100% to the displayed dropoff modifier.
13: Fuel lost by the target per second when hit by this weapon. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up. A negative amount means fuel is added.
14: Increases the target's heat by this amount per second. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up.
15: Reduces the target's energy by this amount per second. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up.
16: Reduces the target's energy. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up. Ionization slowly wears off over time.
17: Increases the target's chance of weapon failure. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up. Scrambling slowly wears off over time.
18: Reduces the target's turn rate, acceleration, and top speed. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up. Slowing wears off over time.
19: Allows weapon damage to "leak through" to the hull even if shields are up. Shield disruption wears off over time, and adding additional shield disruption becomes more difficult as damage leaks past shields instead of disrupting them.
20: Shield damage dealt over time by this weapon per second.
21: Hull damage dealt over time by this weapon per second.
22: Fuel damage dealt over time by this weapon per second.
23: Heat damage dealt over time by this weapon per second.
24: Shield damage dealt per second, as a percentage of the target's total shield strength.
25: Hull damage dealt per second, as a percentage of the target's total hull strength.
26: Minable damage dealt per second, as a percentage of the target's total health.
27: Fuel loss caused per second as a percentage of the target's total fuel capacity. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up.
28: Increases the target's heat as a percentage of its maximum heat capacity by this amount per second. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up.
29: Reduces the target's energy as a percentage of its energy capacity by this amount per second. Only half as effective when the target's shields are up.
33: Hull damage dealt to your ship per second.
34: Shield damage dealt to your ship per second.
35: Reduces energy levels for some time after this weapon is fired.
36: Increases the chance of weapon failure for some time after this weapon is fired.
37: Reduces the turn rate, acceleration, and top speed of the ship when this weapon is fired. Slowing wears off over time.
